picks.title: 另一个妈妈
picks.summary: 改编自乔什·马勒曼的小说《屋中异闻》。贝拉与父母生活在关系日渐紧张的家庭中。一天，一个与母亲长相相同的邪恶实体出现，并逐渐威胁到贝拉及其家人的安全。
picks.summaryEn: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

picks.title: 守护你，遇见爱
picks.summary: 一名不苟言笑的保镖奉命在假期保护一位魅力四射的动作明星，结果两人擦出火花，秘密接连曝光，圣诞节也变得异常复杂。
picks.summaryEn: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.
